`example.heic` is the libheif project's example HEIC image, downloaded from
https://github.com/strukturag/libheif/blob/master/examples/example.heic.
It is used only for offline decoder regression tests (1280 × 854 primary image).
It is not displayed in the production store or sent to real recipients.
Upstream licensing: https://github.com/strukturag/libheif/blob/master/COPYING.
